result.reply:
Three's the threshold — that's a real "we've hit this three times" case, not premature abstraction. So yes, in principle, pull it out.

But before I commit to a shape: are the three call sites actually the same logic, or just similarly-shaped? Specifically — same retry conditions (which exceptions/status codes trigger a retry), same backoff params (base delay, max attempts, jitter or not)? If they're identical, a plain helper function works. If they differ on any of those, the helper needs to take config rather than hardcode it, and that changes the design.

I haven't seen the three call sites, so I don't want to guess. Can you paste them or point me at them? Once I see whether the divergence is real or cosmetic, I'll write the actual plan.
